name: RAIC Eastern Regional Open Data Centre, Kenema
developer: Right to Access Information Commission (RAIC) Sierra Leone
notes: Public open-data/resource centre at RAIC Eastern Regional Office in Kenema City, furnished with computers and internet facilities (World Bank-supported regional open data centres). Institutional public resource centre, NOT a commercial colocation or telecom data center; included for coverage because it is an officially named 'regional open data centre' with a location. Eastern division otherwise showed no commercial DC activity in method-driven searches.

name: RAIC Northern Regional Open Data Centre, Makeni
developer: Right to Access Information Commission (RAIC) Sierra Leone
notes: Public open-data/resource centre at RAIC Northern Regional Office in Makeni (Northern provincial headquarters). Institutional public resource centre, NOT a commercial colocation or telecom data center. Northern division otherwise showed no commercial DC activity (Makeni/Kabala searches negative; Orange Bo announcement mentions Makeni service coverage but no Northern site).

Method-driven searches for Port Loko, Lungi, Kambia (data centre/data center/colocation/server room/ICT project) found no datacenter facility or project. Jui (home of the Leonecom MMR meet-me room) belongs to Western Area Rural, not North Western, so it is not counted here.

name: Orange Sierra Leone Bo Data Centre
notes: President Bio officially opened the Orange Sierra Leone Data Centre in Bo City on 2025-11-29 (State House release). Orange CTO described it as the company's disaster-recovery data centre, the second such installation after Freetown; a full-scale replica of the Freetown centre. Reported EUR23m (US$26.7m) investment. Capacity MW not disclosed (kept null per methodology - only first-party figures accepted).

name: Africell Data Centre at Tech and Innovation City, Tikonko (Bo District)
developer: Africell Sierra Leone; Ministry of Communication, Technology and Innovation
notes: Africell committed under MoU (Jun 2024) to build an ultra-modern data centre in the planned 130-acre Tech City Special Economic Zone in Tikonko chiefdom, Bo District, reportedly open to third parties; part of the US$150m Tech City project led by the Ministry of Communication, Technology and Innovation. No construction/completion evidence found - status planned.

name: RAIC Southern Regional Open Data Centre, Bo
developer: Right to Access Information Commission (RAIC) Sierra Leone
notes: Public open-data/resource centre at RAIC Southern Regional Office in Bo. Institutional public resource centre, NOT a commercial colocation or telecom data center; listed for coverage as an officially named regional open data centre with location. Distinct from the Orange Bo Data Centre.

name: Orange Sierra Leone Freetown Data Centre
developer: Orange Sierra Leone (ex-Airtel Sierra Leone, acquired 2016)
notes: Orange's primary/main data centre in Freetown, launched 2018 after a 2016 groundbreaking by the then-Airtel unit (per DCD, 8 Dec 2025); described by State House/Orange as the main centre of which Bo is the disaster-recovery replica. DCD (grade B detail): 940 sqm site, 350 sqm white space, capacity for 154 racks. MW capacity not disclosed by first-party sources, so capacity_mw kept null.

name: Zoodlabs Data Centre / ACE Cable Landing Station, Freetown
developer: Zoodlabs (SL) Limited (ACE landing station manager; Sierra Leone Cable Ltd SALCAB agreement)
notes: Zoodlabs manages the ACE submarine cable landing station in Freetown (per MoCTI National Broadband Strategy 2023-2028 and GoSL operational agreement) and operates its 'Zoodlabs Data Centre' there: CrossBoundary Energy (A/B supplier source) powers it with 0.8 MWp solar, 0.7 MW thermal generation and 1.95 MWh storage (commissioned Q2 2023). colo.exchange directory (grade C) lists a 'Zoodlabs CLS MMR' colocation facility on Bendu's Drive, Lumley Beach area, Freetown - public colocation offering unverified by operator first-party pages. Power figures are supply-system ratings, not IT load, so capacity_mw kept null. The CLS/MMR is a landing-station/interconnection asset rather than a standalone commercial DC.

name: Afcom Data Center & Colocation, Freetown
notes: Afcom's own corporate pages advertise a Sierra Leone-owned data center and colocation service (and cloud computing), located in Freetown (operator address at Lumley Beach Rd area, Freetown, per operator pages and directory listings). No capacity, rack count or launch date disclosed - capacity_mw null.

name: Africell Data Center, Freetown (seafront, Lumley Beach Road)
notes: Groundbreaking for Africell's seafront data centre at 30F Lumley Beach Road, Freetown (Jun 2022, per DCD and Construction Review Online); intended first as Africell's disaster-recovery centre, later open to third-party infrastructure and possibly a second subsea cable. A later DFC delegation visit photo shows the state-of-the-art centre under construction. No confirmed operational status found - status kept construction.

name: SMART Sierra Leone national data centres (Government of Sierra Leone / China deal)
developer: Government of Sierra Leone; China National Technical Import & Export Corporation
notes: US$50m SMART Sierra Leone agreement (Sep 2024) includes establishing national data centers to manage/protect sovereign data and securing critical state infrastructure in Freetown. Exact sites and capacities not disclosed; assigned to Western Area because of the Freetown infrastructure reference. Pipeline/planned - no official commissioning or construction evidence yet.

name: RAIC Western Region Open Data Centre, Freetown
developer: Right to Access Information Commission (RAIC) Sierra Leone
notes: RAIC Western Region public data resource centre unveiled 2019-12-12 (46 Kroo Town Road, Freetown). Institutional public resource centre, NOT a commercial colocation or hyperscale data center. Note: Michcom-IX/SLIX/SLIXP internet exchange and Leonecom MMR (Jui) interconnection assets exist in Western Area but are treated as IXP/meet-me records, not independent data centers, per methodology.
